stem.text: The structure of compound X is shown.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of compound X, labelled X: a five-membered lactone ring containing a ring O and a C=O group, with a methyl substituent on the carbon next to the ring O.

stem.text: What is produced when X is heated with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$?

A.alt: Skeletal structure of HOCH2CH(CH3)CH2COONa (sodium carboxylate with a terminal OH).

B.alt: Skeletal structure of HOCH2CH(CH3)CH2COOH (carboxylic acid with a terminal OH).

C.alt: Skeletal structure of HOCH(CH3)CH2CH2COONa (sodium carboxylate with a secondary OH).

D.alt: Skeletal structure of HOCH(CH3)CH2CH2COOH (carboxylic acid with a secondary OH).
